authKinds.user: a session or any agent token; else 401 unauthorized
authKinds.session: a session; else 401 unauthorized, a token 403 session_required
authKinds.everything:read: a session, or a token with an `all` grant of at least read; else 401 unauthorized, another token 403 agent_scope
authKinds.everything:manage: a session, or a token with an `all` grant at manage; else 401 unauthorized, another token 403 agent_scope
authKinds.admin: an administrator with a session; else 401 unauthorized, a token 403 session_required, a non-administrator 403 forbidden
authKinds.admin:everything:manage: an administrator with a session or a token with `all` at manage; else 401 unauthorized, another token 403 agent_scope, a non-administrator 403 forbidden
authKinds.admin:everything:manage+session: as admin:everything:manage, and a token gets 403 session_required
